up: Return the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds that have been tested against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5162 (Neuropeptide S receptor) in assays where the assay organism is Homo sapiens.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5162' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
